; Apply only the missing-field default; preserve all explicit selections.
; Installed only on the verified 20260827113527 firmware and resource table.
AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
    IMPORT org.reweread.NativeDefaults 1.0
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            Item {
                id: nativeReaderContrastDefaults
                Component.onCompleted: console.info("native reader contrast defaults ready")
                Connections {
                    target: root
                    function onDocumentOpened(document) {
                        if (document && ReaderDefaults.needsContrastDefault(
                                String(document.id), document.viewBackgroundFilter)) {
                            DocumentController.setViewBackgroundFilter(document.id, "off");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
